title: NutriScan Analysis Response
description: LOCKED API contract for /api/v1/scan/ endpoint. This schema is frozen for frontend development. Any breaking changes require version increment.

scan_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific scan event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the scan was processed.

status.description: Pipeline processing status: success (full extraction), partial_ocr_failure (low confidence OCR), unreadable (failed OCR).

user_context_used.description: Echo of the user profile used for personalized analysis.

age_months.description: User age in months. Null if not provided. Used for infant safety checks.

ocr_raw_text.description: Raw text extracted from the label via OCR. Used for debugging and user correction.

ocr_confidence.description: OCR confidence score (0-1). Values < 0.6 trigger partial_ocr_failure status.

parsed_ingredients.description: Structured list of ingredients identified from the label.

name.description: Canonical ingredient name (e.g., 'Salt' instead of 'Sodium Chloride').

original_text.description: Original text from label before normalization.

risk_level.description: Safety assessment: safe (green), caution (yellow), avoid (red), unknown (gray).

description.description: Plain-language explanation of the ingredient and its purpose.

nutrition_facts.description: Nutrition information per serving. Optional if not present on label.

allergen_alerts.description: List of detected allergens with severity. Always present (empty array if none).

severity.description: Alert priority: high (bold red), medium (orange), low (yellow).

evidence.description: Quote from label triggering this alert (e.g., 'Contains Casein').

dietary_compliance.description: Compliance flags for dietary restrictions. Optional if not analyzed.

is_halal.description: True if compliant, false if not, null if uncertain.

is_infant_safe.description: Safe for infants < 12 months (e.g., no honey, low sugar).

health_impact_summary.description: Overall health assessment with traffic light verdict.

verdict.description: Traffic light mapping: excellent/good=green, fair=yellow, poor/hazardous=red.

detailed_analysis.description: Full markdown-formatted analysis with regulatory citations.

traffic_light.description: UI traffic light color derived from verdict. Maps: excellent/good→green, fair→yellow, poor/hazardous→red.

why.description: Plain-language explanation of the verdict. Combines short_summary and key risk factors.

citations.description: Regulatory sources cited in the analysis. Maps to 'sources' field.

better_swaps.description: Alternative product suggestions. Maps to 'suggestions' with type='swap'.

reason.description: Why this alternative is better (e.g., 'Lower sodium', 'No artificial colors').

suggestions.description: Usage tips and product swaps. Includes both better_swaps and general tips.

type.description: swap = alternative product, usage_tip = how to consume safely.

product_name.description: Required for type=swap, omitted for usage_tip.

sources.description: Regulatory sources from RAG retrieval. Same as 'citations'.

latency_ms.description: Total processing time in milliseconds. For performance monitoring.

regulatory_flags.description: List of regulatory violations or warnings.

examples.description: Complete OCR extraction with high confidence, product passes all checks.

data.ocr_raw_text:
Organic Oat Milk
INGREDIENTS: Water, Organic Oats (14%), Sunflower Oil, Sea Salt
NUTRITION FACTS (per 100ml): Calories 45, Sugar 4g, Sodium 100mg, Fat 1.5g

parsed_ingredients.name: Organic Oats
parsed_ingredients.description: Whole grain, high in fiber and nutrients.

health_impact_summary.short_summary: Clean, plant-based product with minimal processing and no harmful additives.
health_impact_summary.detailed_analysis: This organic oat milk contains only 4 simple ingredients, all recognized as safe by the Punjab Food Authority. Sugar content (4g/100ml) is within acceptable limits for beverages. No artificial preservatives, colors, or allergens detected. Suitable for vegan diets and infant consumption (6+ months).

data.why: All ingredients are natural and safe. Low sugar, no harmful additives, and complies with vegan dietary requirements.

citations.excerpt: Plant-based beverages must not exceed 5g sugar per 100ml for health compliance.

suggestions.reason: Shake well before use as natural separation may occur.

examples.description: OCR succeeded but with low confidence due to poor image quality or complex label design.

- Blurry or low-resolution image
- Poor lighting conditions
- Label text too small or damaged
- Non-English/Urdu script not yet supported

**Action Required**: Please retake the photo with better lighting and focus, ensuring the ingredients list is clearly visible.
